meta.name: hackernews
meta.description: Search Hacker News for relevant tech discussions, product launches, and engagement opportunities using the public Algolia API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索 Hacker News 上的技术讨论与产品发布
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想追踪科技热点并参与社区讨论
copy.tagline_en: Search Hacker News for tech discussions and product launches
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to stay on top of Hacker News discussions and product launches

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能搜索 Hacker News 上的技术讨论、产品发布等内容,阅读帖子与评论,并根据 HN 社区风格起草回复,还能把互动情况存成报告。
howto.when: 当你说“check HN”等指令,或要求搜索/监测 HN 讨论、起草回帖时触发。

say.text: 搜索 Hacker News 最近一周关于 ai agents 的帖子
say.note: 会列出相关帖子,可按时间和热度排序。

say.text: 帮我把这条 HN 帖子的评论读一遍,总结讨论焦点
say.note: 需提供帖子 ID,会拉取完整评论树。

say.text: 根据这个帖子帮我起草一条技术向的 HN 回复
say.note: 会遵循 HN 的行文风格,避免营销语气。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search Hacker News for tech discussions and product launches via the Algolia API, read full threads and comment trees, draft concise technical replies, and save engagement reports to docs/hackernews/.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says "check HN" or asks to search/monitor HN discussions, draft replies, or generate engagement reports.

say_en.text: Search Hacker News for posts about ai agents from the last week
say_en.note: Lists relevant posts, sortable by time or popularity.

say_en.text: Read the comments of this HN thread and summarize the discussion
say_en.note: Provide the post ID to fetch the full comment tree.

say_en.text: Draft a technical HN reply based on this thread
say_en.note: Follows HN tone guidelines, avoiding marketing language.
